repo_state.summary: bin/new-zellij-project-layout.sh now generates single-pane claude, codex, and grok tabs; a code tab running nvim; and two-pane tools and shell tabs. README documents the layout. Existing local layouts require --force regeneration, and an existing named Zellij session must be deleted before the new layout structure appears.

New scripts stow package installs ~/.local/bin/theme-toggle (Catppuccin latte<->macchiato toggle for Alacritty + Zellij via live config reload, explicit flavours + status supported); both bootstrap scripts stow it; zellij config normalized to a single theme line; zshrc gained grok CLI PATH/completions block.
bin/bootstrap-macos.sh supports --minimal for shell/Zellij essentials; bin/check-health.sh supports matching --minimal verification; README documents both commands.
